hero.title: Build for every direction.
hero.subtitle: A Nuxt 3 starter with English and Persian, RTL layouts, dark mode, Pinia Setup Stores and strict TypeScript — configured before you write your first component.

features.title: Everything is already wired up
features.subtitle: Skip the infrastructure work and start building the product.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: English and Persian catalogues, lazy loading and URL prefixes handled by {'@'}nuxtjs/i18n.

rtl.title: Right-to-left layouts
rtl.description: Direction and fonts follow the active locale, using logical CSS properties only.

theme.title: Light, dark and system
theme.description: Color mode is persisted per visitor and applied before the first paint, with no flash.

stores.title: Pinia Setup Stores
stores.description: Typed state with localStorage persistence, written in the Composition API style.

typescript.title: Strict TypeScript
typescript.description: No any types, generated route types and a typecheck script wired into CI.

quality.title: Quality gates
quality.description: ESLint flat config, Prettier, Husky hooks and GitHub Actions on every push.

demo.title: Live demo
demo.subtitle: Switch the language or the theme and watch the whole page follow.

about.title: About this starter
about.intro: nuxt-i18n-starter exists so a bilingual product can start on solid ground instead of a blank folder.
about.languageBody: English is the default locale and lives at the root URL. Persian is served under /fa with a right-to-left document, translated navigation and Vazirmatn typography.
about.stateBody: The settings store keeps the locale and color mode in a Pinia Setup Store, and persists both choices in localStorage so they survive reloads.
about.directionBody: Layouts use logical properties such as ms-, me-, ps- and pe- instead of left and right, so one set of styles serves both writing directions.
about.stackBody: Nuxt 3, Vue 3 Composition API, Pinia, Tailwind CSS, {'@'}nuxtjs/i18n, {'@'}nuxtjs/color-mode, ESLint, Prettier and Husky.
